title: Minimum ASCII Delete Sum for Two Strings
summary: For strings s1 and s2, determine the minimum total ASCII value of characters that need to be deleted to make both strings identical.
statement: For strings s1 and s2, determine the minimum total ASCII value of characters that need to be deleted to make both strings identical.
constraints: Delete characters from either string until equal while minimizing the sum of deleted ASCII values.
hints: The decision at two suffixes is keep equal leading characters or delete one unequal leader.
Use suffix dynamic programming with one rolling row.
If characters match take diagonal; otherwise min(ord(left)+below, ord(right)+right).
Every valid common result begins with both equal leaders or omits at least one unequal leader, making the recurrence exhaustive.

tests.explanation: Keeping ea deletes s and t, whose ASCII values total 231.
Keeping let yields a minimum deletion sum of 403.
